svg.title: Ius Membership Card Reconstructed
svg.desc: Geometrically rebuilt membership card, with $10 per year voting-member and $5 non-voting-supporter choices as visible in the supplied historical photographs. The small original statement-of-support body is omitted because it cannot be transcribed confidently. Historic artwork for reference, not a current registration or payment form.
